senses.gloss:
r. 6th cl. (लिखति)
To write.
r. 1st cl. (लेखति)
To go.

m. (-खः)
1 Writing.
2 A writer.
E.
लिख to write, क aff.

mfn. (-खन्-खन्ती-खती-खत्)
1 Writing.
2 Painting, delineating.
3 Scratching, making streaks or lines.
E.
लिख to write, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Scripture, writing.
2 A writing, a written document.
3 Scratching.
4 Scarifying.
E.
लिख to write, aff. क्युच्, and the vowel unchanged.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Written.
2 Drawn, delineated, painted: (painting being considered a sort of writing)
3 Drawn as lines, scratched.
4 Scarified.
n. (-तं)
1 Scripture, writing.
2 A writing, a manuscript, a written book or paper.
E.
लिख to write, aff. क्त.

ind.
Having written, delineated, &c.
E.
लिख to write, क्त्वाच् aff.

f. (-ख्या)
A poppy seed, considered as a minute measure of weight, variously estimated at four or eight Trasareṇus or motes, or the sixth part of a mustard seed, &c.
E.
लिख to write, क्यप् aff.
